details.description: Enhanced General is the general-purpose model in Deepgram's Enhanced speech-to-text tier, optimized for everyday audio processing; Deepgram's documentation lists it together with the plain "enhanced" model option as the same model. Deepgram states it is likely to be more accurate than any region-specific Base-tier model for a given language, and recommends it as the starting point when unsure which model to choose. Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview currently groups the Enhanced tier, together with Base and Nova 1, under "Legacy Models", behind its newer Nova-3 and Flux offerings.
advantages: Deepgram describes it as likely more accurate than any region-specific Base model for the language it supports, and recommends it as the default starting point if unsure which model to select.
Deepgram states Enhanced-tier models generally have higher accuracy and better word recognition than its Base-tier models, and handle uncommon words significantly better.

Supports 17 languages, including Danish, Dutch, English, Flemish, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Spanish, Swedish, Tamasheq and Tamil, per Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview.
disadvantages: Deepgram groups the Enhanced tier under "Legacy Models" in its Models & Languages Overview, alongside Base and Nova 1.
Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview does not list Chinese, Indonesian, Russian, Turkish or Ukrainian support for this model, though its own Base-general model does support them.
use_cases: Default choice for use cases needing better accuracy and uncommon-word recognition than Deepgram's Base tier

notes: Deepgram's language table lists this model's row as 'enhanced or enhanced-general', i.e. this model is documented as the same option as the plain 'enhanced' id (a separate catalog slug); descriptions and language lists for the two are therefore based on the same source row. No word-error-rate or other accuracy figures specific to this model were found on Deepgram's maker pages, so evaluations is left empty. The catalog carries no deprecation_date for this model.
